edge_cases: token-mixing weights Wt1/Wt2 are SHARED across every channel d (applying the SAME 1-D MLP independently per channel) -- the defining Mixer structure, distinct from any per-row FFN
channel-mixing weights Wc1/Wc2 are SHARED across every token s -- a normal transformer FFN reduction, but over the OTHER (feature) axis of the same tensor
token-mix hidden saturation columns: bt1[0]=-4000 (always-kill), bt1[1]=+4000 (always-fire)
token-mix output saturation columns: bt2[0]=-300 (sat-low), bt2[1]=+300 (sat-high)
channel-mix hidden saturation columns: bc1[0]=-4000 (always-kill), bc1[1]=+4000 (always-fire)
channel-mix output saturation columns: bc2[0]=-300 (sat-low), bc2[1]=+300 (sat-high)
reduction lengths S=32/St=64/D=64/Dff=64 are all <128 -- every HVX dot uses a partial-vector predicate mask (Q6_Q_vsetq_R)
nearmiss_skip_token_residual drops the FIRST (token-mixing) residual add (Y=TMo, no +X) -> INCORRECT (1455/2048 wrong)
name: i8_mlp_mixer_block
signal: MLP-Mixer block: token-mixing MLP (mix over sequence axis) then channel-mixing MLP (mix over feature axis), each with ReLU activation + residual
